hebrewText: מִ֤י הֵעִיר֙ מִ/מִּזְרָ֔ח צֶ֖דֶק יִקְרָאֵ֣/הוּ לְ/רַגְל֑/וֹ יִתֵּ֨ן לְ/פָנָ֤י/ו גּוֹיִם֙ וּ/מְלָכִ֣ים יַ֔רְדְּ יִתֵּ֤ן כֶּֽ/עָפָר֙ חַרְבּ֔/וֹ כְּ/קַ֥שׁ נִדָּ֖ף קַשְׁתּֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
tokens.kjv: any (man), [idiom] he, [idiom] him, [phrase] O that! what, which, who(-m, -se, -soever), [phrase] would to God.
(a-) wake(-n, up), lift up (self), [idiom] master, raise (up), stir up (self).

tokens.kjv: [idiom] even, ([idiom] that which is altogether) just(-ice), (un-)right(-eous) (cause, -ly, -ness).
